list.description: Owns SQLite migrations and repositories, runtime configuration, credential protection, pairing, outbound policy, logging, and supervised execution foundations.

list.description: Bridges the native product to the local runtime, HTTPS management service, Android lifecycle, display power, motor hardware, and system-service contracts.
